title: No check mark for a checker started by a workflow
what: plugins/core/hooks/check-mark.py reads the Report: label from the transcript's FIRST line; a workflow agent's first line is the harness relay of the user's request ("[Workflow harness — user request] ..."), and the real prompt is the next user entry, so the hook says "the checker's prompt has no Report: line" and writes no mark.
why: The owner chose background workflows for parallel changes (24 Oct, "а, давай пробу сценариями после шага 2"); every workflow-run change then needs the front to write its mark by hand, or its merge is refused.
failing_case: Trial 24 Oct (workflow wf_0f6e557b-2f8): checkers for wt/openspec-install and wt/no-merge-page finished with open 0, but no "relay: check of" commit appeared; feeding the hook the second user entry of the same transcript wrote the marks (c3aea5f, bb5c586).
pass_cases: A checker whose transcript starts with the workflow harness relay gets its mark; a plain Agent-tool checker still does; a transcript with no Report: label in any of its first user entries still writes nothing and says why.
